t1.text: ranma.masshiro.pro: one page, the front door

n1.text: Identity: the 欄間 is the hero. The demo sits in a doorway with a carved lattice above it, and every section is a panel framed like a ranma pane (rounded border, ' 1 · title ' on the top edge, the focused one in hinoki). The palette is sumi (ink, washi, hinoki), the theme in the README screenshot, rather than default.toml's blues: it is ranma's own, it is literally wood, and it carries a light variant (washi ground, ink text, darker hinoki for text so it passes 4.5:1).

n2.text: Type: IBM Plex Sans for prose, JetBrains Mono for everything a terminal would show (keys, code, the bar-shaped nav, pane titles), Shippori Mincho for the one 欄間. All three self-hosted as woff2 subsets in site/fonts/ (the canvas loads them from Google Fonts only to preview). Mono carries the subject; the sans keeps it from reading like a README.

n3.text: Demo medium: a video, not a cast and not the GIF. 1600×900, muted autoplay loop, WebM (AV1) with an MP4 (H.264) fallback, poster = screenshot.png. About a tenth of the GIF's 2.8 MB, and it plays with JavaScript off (<video controls>). Chapters as a WebVTT track; the chips under it are plain links with media fragments (#t=12). A cast would lose the Nerd Font glyphs, the kitty images and the exact theme, and needs a player script.

n4.text: Capture list (the dashed 'capture' tags; the 'Capture notes' tweak hides them): 1 hero video as above. 2 sessions: 6 s loop, leader d, terminal closes, `ranma`, back where it was, then the session switcher. 3 copy mode: 6 s loop, search back, select, yank, paste on the local side of an ssh pane. 4 images: still, a kitty-protocol image in a pane beside text. 5 mobile: still, 390-wide portrait of the mobile view. 6 tiling: optional stills, one per layout; the drawn schematics stand without them. The bar card reuses the screenshot's top strip.

n5.text: Build-time values: version, release date and the release link come from Cargo.toml and the latest tag; the page has three slots for them (the nav pill, the install heading, the footer). The canvas shows 0.4.0 from Cargo.toml as sample data in the 'version' tweak; nothing is typed by hand on the site.

n6.text: Install: nothing is collapsed. The one-liner leads in the hero and again at Install; each channel is a row with its own copy button; apt and dnf get full blocks beside each other (one copy button for the block, lines scroll sideways in their box at phone width, never wrap). The URLs stay at masshirodev.github.io/ranma. Without JS the copy buttons are hidden (they are added by a few lines of script) and every command stays selectable.

n7.text: Theme: follows prefers-color-scheme; the nav button overrides it and remembers the choice in localStorage. Without JS the system setting decides. Later, not now: a rendered docs section (man pages and CONFIG.md as HTML, generated at build time from the same sources) is worth it once the site exists; today it links to them on GitHub.
